Route map: list every HTTP route that the GitNexus web server (`gitnexus serve`) registers in `gitnexus/src/server/`: the HTTP method and the path of each (for example `GET /api/health`). Include every method (GET, POST, DELETE, ...) and any route that accepts all methods (use method `ALL` for those).

Do not modify any repository files. Write `.bench-review/answer.json` as UTF-8 JSON with exactly this shape:
{"routes": [{"method": "GET", "path": "/api/health"}]}
Then reply with a one-line summary.

Tool map: list the names of all MCP tools that the GitNexus MCP server defines (the tools an MCP client can call).

Do not modify any repository files. Write `.bench-review/answer.json` as UTF-8 JSON with exactly this shape:
{"tools": ["tool_name", "..."]}
Then reply with a one-line summary.

Do not modify any repository files. Write `.bench-review/answer.json` as UTF-8 JSON with exactly this shape:
